correctness.rationale: For P=gh in M2(F_q), D_P={A: PA=A=AP} is Hom(V/im(P-I),ker(P-I)); if dim ker(P-I)=d, both kernel and quotient have dimension d and domain dimension d^2, i.e. 0,1,4. d=0 gives partial id {0}, d=2 global conjugation PGL2(q). Rank-one domains split idempotent lines (q(q+1) source lines) and square-zero lines (q+1 source lines). Each ordered pair of idempotent lines has one arrow; each square-zero pair has q-1 scalar arrows. Choosing P=e or P=I+N and h=U realizes all via conjugation; distinct lines intersect only in 0, implying two Brandt components with common zero, and closure under globals. Total q(q²-1)+1+q²(q+1)²+(q-1)(q+1)². Independently enumerated every M2(F2) generator map and every 2704 ordered composition, confirming 52 maps; inspected source verify_linear_inner.py for F3 too (not independently executed).
